prompt:

Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — rigging, a ship's wheel, coiled ropes, wooden stairs up to the quarterdeck and billowing sails
Outfit: a ballet stage costume — a fitted bodice, a short stiff tutu and satin pointe shoes — in one bright, saturated colour such as cherry red, cobalt blue, sunflower yellow or kelly green; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; back to the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small hand lantern low at her side; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most the one small accessory below.

Her legend — benevolence and humility that win hearts, humble straw-sandal beginnings under imperial Han blood, long jade earrings as her mark of fortune, the twin swords of the Peach Garden oath, tears shed for her people — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Accessory: off duty she carries no weapon or armour — her signature weapon (a pair of matched twin swords in one double scabbard) appears only as a pendant on a fine chain modelled on its shape and colours, a few centimetres long, clearly jewellery.

Light: the place's own light, with a strong soft rim light tracing her hair and shoulders, glossy highlights on skin and jewellery and drifting light particles — a luxurious promotional glow.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

observations: 1024x1536; same adult woman as the selected reference; no full-size weapon, crown or armour.
No obvious extra limbs; visible hands and held props reviewed; no logo or watermark.
